Subject: Post-demo: data access assurances & support access next steps

Thanks again for your time on today's demo — appreciated the practical questions. Quick recap and proposed next steps related to the data handling and support access items you asked about: 

1) PII & data minimization
- Redwood does not persist customer-provided user inputs by default in Dedicated/Private deployments. For our hosted product we keep request logs for troubleshooting; retention window is configurable per-account.
- You asked about a "redaction at ingestion" option: we can add a preprocessing step to strip or token‑replace fields (emails, SSNs) before they reach the model.

2) Retention & logging controls
- Default hosted retention: 30 days logs, 90 days aggregated metrics. We can offer a custom retention policy in the DPA/SLA.
- Audit logs include per-request metadata (request ID, model, route, timestamp) and operator actions.

3) Access controls: RBAC, least privilege, break‑glass
- RBAC: roles (Admin, DevOps, Dev, ReadOnly, Support) with resource-scoped permissions.
- Least privilege: recommended initial mapping attached (support-access-matrix.xlsx).
- Break‑glass: we support time-bound emergency access events that are fully audited and require a justification token plus email escalation.

4) Support access & observable evidence
- For troubleshooting we can provide temporary session tokens for live debugging; all actions are recorded. We can also provide redacted session transcripts on request.

Proposed next steps:
- I attached a short DPA summary (redwood-dpa-summary.pdf) and the support access matrix. Please confirm which retention window you want evaluated (30/90/custom) and whether FinMetrics requires data residency in a US-only region or a specific cloud region.
- If helpful, I can schedule a 30-min technical sync with our security engineer (stephanie_nguyen) to walk through the break-glass flow and audit logs next week.

Thanks — Mark

Thanks Markus — useful recap. A few clarifying items from our side after internal sync: 

- Residency: FinMetrics needs customer data (including PII) to remain in US regions only for the pilot. Can Redwood guarantee model execution and raw logs are stored in a US region?
- Retention: we prefer 30 days for raw logs, but want aggregated metrics kept for 12 months for trending. Is that configurable?
- Break-glass: can you provide the exact audit fields captured during a break-glass event (who, when, justification text, duration, actions performed)? We need to map them to our SOC evidence requirements.
- Support access: is there an option to restrict support sessions to only metadata (no payload) unless explicit approval is given?

Happy to do the technical sync. Rajesh (CC) will coordinate schedule. Also, can you share a short example of the audit log schema or a sample redacted log?

Best,
Anika
Director, Product Security
FinMetrics Inc.
Anika@finmetrics.com

Anika — great questions, addressed inline and attaching a sample redacted audit log excerpt: 

- Residency: Yes. For Hosted we can pin the account to a US-only region (us-west2 or us-east1). All persisted logs and backups for that account will remain in the selected region. For Dedicated/Private you control physical location.

- Retention: Configurable. We can set raw request/log retention to 30 days and export aggregated metrics rollups to your BI store for 12 months. I noted that in the attachment names and will surface it in the DPA addendum.

- Break-glass audit fields (sample): event_id, triggered_by (user id), trigger_time, justification_text, access_duration_seconds, resources_accessed (IDs), operator_actions (list of API calls), redaction_state, escalation_emails. I'll include a sanitized example log excerpt in the Drive link I just shared.

- Support access restriction: we support a metadata-only troubleshooting mode (no payload) — support can request payload-level access which then requires a 2-step approval (customer approver + an automated justification token) and is time-limited.

Next steps I propose:
- Technical deep dive (30 min) with Stephanie to walk the break-glass flow and show the sample logs.
- Send a brief DPA addendum that lists the configurable retention windows and region pinning options.

Proposed times: Wed 5/13 10:00am PT or Thu 5/14 2:00pm PT. Rajesh / Anika — which works?

Cheers,
Mark
